decision_rule: Individual verdict per agent of the arm: 'fault_suspected' or 'no_fault_found' = that agent's LATEST submit_assessment (citing >= 1 measurement); 'incomplete' = the agent filed none. Team decision: FLAGGED iff at least one individual verdict is fault_suspected; NOT_FLAGGED iff every agent of the arm filed no_fault_found; otherwise INCOMPLETE (no alarm raised and at least one agent incomplete). PRIMARY metrics count INCOMPLETE as not flagged (an arm gets no credit for a verdict it did not produce); incomplete cases and incomplete individual verdicts are reported separately, and SECONDARY metrics are computed over complete cases only. The deterministic baseline is FLAGGED iff any pre-registered rule triggers (never incomplete).

reserve.release_rule: an agent's unused reserve is withheld from the other agents until it files its first assessment or exits, then returns to the common pool; an agent that has not assessed receives one final turn before the run may end

upper_bound_budget.note: input cap is enforced per case by pre-call reservation (estimate-based); output tokens are additional (soft)
